entities.name: surreal-memory-server
observations: Rust MCP server for SurrealDB knowledge graph, mindmaps, and task streams
Docker Compose at /Users/gqadonis/Projects/references/surreal-memory-server/docker-compose.yaml
Running at localhost:23001 via Docker
Claude Desktop config: /mcp/http endpoint (Streamable HTTP — NOT /mcp/sse which causes handshake ordering failures)
Repo: Prometheus-AGS/surreal-memory-server
Critical fix: mindmap table MUST be SCHEMALESS — SCHEMAFULL rejects MindMapNode sub-fields (color, metadata, node_type)
Critical fix: create_mindmap and create_task_stream use explicit UUID keys — auto-IDs return None in server mode
Critical fix: type::thing removed in SurrealDB 3.x — use type::record($table, $key)
Critical fix: SurrealDB FLEXIBLE syntax is TYPE array<object> FLEXIBLE (FLEXIBLE after TYPE, not before)
Migration history: v1-v12 in /references/ codebase — v6 is SCHEMALESS mindmap, v3 includes auto_summarize/summary_count/model_id
Status: Rebuilt from /references/ directory, schema at v12, connectivity fix in progress
